newsitem.title: USA: S&P upgrades Associated Estates outlook.
newsitem.headline: S&P upgrades Associated Estates outlook.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp revised its outlook on Associated Estates Realty Corp to "positive" from "stable," citing the company's "sound financial position and gradually improving business profile," Associated said Tuesday.
The rating agency also cited the quality of Associated's cash flow and its ability to access capital markets despite its small market capitalization, Associated said.
S&P also noted that Associated is diversifying geographically, expanding beyond its northeast Ohio core market, the company said.
Associated, a real estate investment trust, has said it plans to enter new markets in the Midwest, including Cincinnati, northern Kentucky and Indianapolis.
Associated was up 1/4 to 23-3/8 and was one of the most active stocks on the New York Stock Exchange in morning trading.
